profile.name: Nguyen Manh Dung
profile.title: Backend Software Engineer
profile.location: Tan Phu, Ho Chi Minh City
profile.careerObjective: Aiming to grow into a Senior Backend Engineer / Technical Lead within the next 3 years, specializing in high-concurrency distributed systems built primarily on Go, with Node.js/TypeScript as a complementary stack. Seeking to own architecture decisions at scale, from data consistency and performance optimization to service decomposition, while mentoring engineers and strengthening engineering practices within the team.
profile.summary: Backend Software Engineer with 2.5+ years of experience building high-concurrency, event-driven systems with Go (Gin), Node.js/TypeScript (NestJS), and AWS. Designed and delivered key architectural solutions in production: a Hybrid Fan-out newsfeed with Neo4j graph traversal and Redis caching (API response time from over 1s to under 200ms), Redis Lua Scripts with pessimistic locking for reward redemption under thousands of concurrent requests, and a monolith-to-microservices migration using CQRS with 90%+ test coverage on business-critical modules. Built high-throughput Go workers that process 1M+ records and export multi-GB CSV reports (up to 9 GB) with RAM usage held at 40–80 MB. Reduced direct database reads by 80% at peak traffic through a Redis caching pipeline. Strong fundamentals in concurrency, system design, and cross-service communication (RabbitMQ, WebSocket, GraphQL). Mentored 2 interns who were later hired full-time.
